text: 中颖电子(300327.SZ)公告称，公司收到证监会出具的《关于同意中颖电子股份有限公司向特定对象发行股票注册的批复》，同意公司向特定对象发行股票的注册申请。本次发行应严格按照报送深交所的申报文件和发行方案实施，批复自同意注册之日起12个月内有效。
text_en: Sino Wealth Electronic (300327.SZ) announced that the company received the Approval Reply on Agreeing to the Registration of Sino Wealth Electronic Co., Ltd.'s Issuance of Shares to Specific Objects issued by the CSRC, agreeing to the company's registration application for issuing shares to specific objects. This issuance shall be implemented strictly in accordance with the application documents and issuance plan submitted to the Shenzhen Stock Exchange, and the approval reply shall be valid for 12 months from the date of approval of registration.
